title: TIPS: A Tiny Inference-time Policy for Scaling in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22099v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Masked diffusion language models expose an inference-time choice: which positions become visible after each denoising pass. Many existing decoding methods use hand-designed rules or require visibility to grow monotonically. We present a $\textbf{T}$iny $\textbf{I}$nference-time $\textbf{P}$olicy for $\textbf{S}$caling ($\textbf{TIPS}$), an approximately $600$K-parameter controller that learns both unmasking and remasking while keeping the underlying language model frozen. TIPS uses visibility-aware confidence features and a shallow transformer to select which tokens should be visible, while a fixed schedule controls the expected visible fraction. We train the controller through supervised warmup followed by reinforcement learning from terminal correctness rewards. On GSM8K and MATH-500 with LLaDA-8B-Instruct, the full-canvas and two-block TIPS variants achieve $58.46\%$ and $57.97\%$ micro-averaged accuracy at a budget of $32$ decoder

translated_title: TIPS：一种用于扩散语言模型扩展的微型推理时策略
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散语言模型在推理时面临一个选择：每轮去噪之后哪些位置变得可见。许多现有的解码方法依赖手工设计的规则，或要求可见性单调增长。我们提出了一种微型推理时扩展策略（TIPS），这是一个约60万参数的控制器，它在保持底层语言模型冻结的同时，能够同时学习解掩码与重新掩码。TIPS利用感知可见性的置信度特征和一个浅层Transformer来选择哪些token应该可见，同时由一个固定的时间表控制预期的可见token比例。我们通过监督预热训练，随后利用基于最终答案正确性奖励的强化学习来训练该控制器。在基于LLaDA-8B-Instruct的GSM8K和MATH-500基准测试中，全画布与双分块两种TIPS变体在32个解码器预算下分别取得了58.46%和57.97%的微平均准确率。
tldr: 本文提出TIPS，一个仅约60万参数的微型推理时控制器，通过强化学习同时学习解掩码与重新掩码策略，在保持底层语言模型完全冻结的情况下，显著提升了掩码扩散语言模型在数学推理任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: TIPS is a tiny ~600K-parameter inference-time controller that learns both unmasking and remasking via reinforcement learning, boosting masked diffusion language model performance on math reasoning while keeping the underlying model frozen.
